preconditions.description: The length of the hexadecimal string S must be at most 14.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in S must be valid hexadecimal digits.
At least one character in S must be non-zero.

postconditions.description: If it is not possible to find a valid original string, output 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == len(S) and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: If a valid original string exists, output must be a hexadecimal string of the same length as S.
The output must represent the smallest possible numerical value of the original string.
